Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results originally recorded in the code implementation notebooks. Specifically: (1) Tournament Elo ratings in Table 1 exactly match the values computed in tournament_results.ipynb for both τ=0 and τ=1 conditions across all 16 layers. (2) The puzzle-solving analysis in puzzle_results.ipynb confirms the documented claim that 'final cumulative solve rate exceeds the last layer's rate' (93.0% vs 88.6%). (3) The forgotten puzzle example (Puzzle 58Ib0) in forgotten_puzzle_figure.ipynb demonstrates the exact behavior described in Figure 4, with Rxg7+ being overridden by Kf1. (4) The three-phase progression pattern (early gains +564, middle plateau +50, late gains +1206) is clearly visible in the tournament data. (5) Policy dynamics implementations in policy_metrics.ipynb compute all described metrics (JS divergence, entropy, Kendall's τ).
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: The plan.md file exists and all plan steps appear in the implementation. Methodology steps: (1) Post-LN logit lens extension is implemented in leela_logit_lens.py with zero ablation. (2) T82-768x15x24h model analysis is conducted throughout all notebooks using lc0-original.onnx. (3) Tournament evaluation is implemented in tournament.py and tournament_results.ipynb with BayesElo computation. (4) Policy dynamics characterization is implemented in policy_metrics.ipynb. (5) Concept preference analysis is implemented in evaluate_concepts.py. All six experiments from the plan are implemented: internal tournament, Lichess deployment (results present in documentation), puzzle-solving by difficulty, solution discovery/forgetting, intermediate policy dynamics, and layer-wise concept preference evolution.
